subject: general
question: Who among the following is an Indian badminton player?
solution:
The correct answer is __**B Sai Praneeth.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **B Sai Praneeth is an Indian badminton player.**
 
• He was born on 10th August 1992 in Hyderabad.
 
• He is the first Indian male badminton player to win the Bronze medal in the BWF World Championship after Prakash Padukone.
 
• Sai Praneeth was honoured with the Arjun Award in 2019.
 
• At present, he trains at the Gopichand Badminton Academy in Hyderabad.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Important Badminton Players of India:
 
• **PV Sindhu** becomes the first Indian Badminton player to win a gold medal in the World Badminton Championship.

 
• Saina Nehwal is an Indian professional badminton singles player.

 
 
• She was awarded Padma Bhushan, Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna, and Arjuna Award.
 
 
 
• Jwala Gutta is an Indian professional badminton player.
 
 
• Jwala Gutta was the first badminton player of India to qualify for two events in the Olympics–women's doubles with Ponnappa and mixed doubles with V. Diju in London.
 
 
 
• Ashwini Ponnappa Machimanda is an Indian badminton player who represents the country at the international badminton circuit in both the women's and mixed doubles disciplines.
